description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldDate class which extends SugarWidgetFieldDateTime, providing methods for displaying date fields within list views and filtering date-based queries in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldDate
classes.description: A class extending SugarWidgetFieldDateTime to handle date field display and query filtering in list views.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Displays the date field in list views, optionally using a column function if specified.

methods.name: queryFilterBefore
methods.description: Generates SQL for filtering records before a certain date.

methods.name: queryFilterAfter
methods.description: Generates SQL for filtering records after a certain date.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals_str
methods.description: Generates SQL for filtering records not matching a specific date or null.

methods.name: queryFilterOn
methods.description: Generates SQL for filtering records on a specific date.

methods.name: queryFilterBetween_Dates
methods.description: Generates SQL for filtering records within a date range.

methods.name: queryMonth
methods.description: Helper method to filter records by a specific month.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current time adjusted for the user's timezone.
